subject: Greenlight: Interview Floorplan & Candidate Ops for Inference Backfill
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenlight: Interview Floorplan & Candidate Ops for Inference Backfill

Team —

Following up on last week's sync: we need to move quickly on the Senior Inference Engineer backfill for the Serving Runtime team (HC-2027-INF-01). TalentGrid flagged a strong candidate, Samir Narayanan (resume attached), who has relevant low‑level inference and kernel optimization experience. He’s available for interviews next week (PST).

Asks:
1) Can People Ops greenlight the req so Marissa can book interviews?
2) Evelyn / Markus — can you confirm the interview slate (technical deep‑dive, systems design, culture) and available slots?
3) Marissa — propose calendar windows + confirm whether we want a short take‑home exercise before loop.

Attachments: Samir_Narayanan_Resume.pdf, JD_Sr_Inference_Engineer_v3.docx

This is prioritized — we had a production incident this morning that underscored the need for additional coverage. If we can open the req and get first round scheduled by EOW, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight: Interview Floorplan & Candidate Ops for Inference Backfill

Logan —

Thanks, looping in schedule. I spoke with TalentGrid and Samir is available Mon/Tue next week in the afternoon (PST). Proposed interview flow (total ~3 hrs):
- 45m: Deep systems/throughput (Markus)
- 60m: Low-level model/inference internals + kernel questions (Evelyn)
- 30m: Behavioral/culture (hiring manager + PM)
- 20m: Quick sync with CS/Platform for ops fit (optional)

I’ve attached a one‑page Interview_Route_Map.pdf with suggested question owners. I recommend a short take‑home: a 2‑hour micro‑exercise (optional, to be completed within 48 hrs) focusing on batch/prefix cache logic — not a full take‑home. Would like to confirm before sending.

Open items for approval:
- Formal headcount open (People Ops) — required to create Greenhouse req
- Salary band confirmation (we have a suggested range but need sign off)
- Candidate timezone confirmed (Samir is PST)

If you approve, I’ll: create the Greenhouse req (INF-452), drop calendar holds, and send Samir the interview plan + optional exercise.

Attachments: Interview_Route_Map.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Technical Hiring
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight: Interview Floorplan & Candidate Ops for Inference Backfill

Logan / Marissa —

Quick yes on the panel. Please ensure the technical loop focuses on inference systems (memory / kv cache behavior, quantized kernels, latency tradeoffs). Markus and I will split the technical questions so we don’t overlap.

On take‑home: I prefer an optional micro‑exercise we can review during the first technical loop — keeps candidate burden low and accelerates evaluation.

Regarding comp band: endorse midpoint range for this role at $160,000–$190,000 base (US, full time) with RSU packet to be discussed if we get to offer.

Also — candidate must be remote‑friendly but able to overlap PST core hours. Samir’s profile looks like he fits that requirement.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Hiring Manager — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick responses. To be explicit: the headcount code HC-2027-INF-01 was pre-approved in the Q2 staffing plan and I’m authorizing Marissa to open the req contingent on People Ops final sign‑off.

Two asks from my side:
- If People Ops can confirm the salary band by EOD tomorrow, we’ll move forward.
- If possible, push the first technical loop earlier in the week — a candidate at risk of offers needs a faster cadence.

If there’s any question on urgency, we had a 90m outage during morning training last week tied to model warming; getting this role filled reduces that risk.

—Logan

Subject: Interview plan & calendar holds — Senior Inference Engineer (Redwood)

Samir — thanks for speaking with TalentGrid. We’d like to move forward with interviews next week. Please see the proposed schedule (all PDT):
- Mon 09:30–10:15 — Systems throughput (Markus Klein)
- Mon 11:00–12:00 — Inference internals (Evelyn Hart)
- Tue 10:00–10:30 — Behavior + team fit (Hiring Manager)

Optional: short 2‑hour micro exercise — we’ll only ask you to complete this if you’d like to demonstrate a specific implementation; it’s not required to proceed.

I’ve created Greenhouse req INF-452 and added initial calendar holds; you should see invites from me. If the times don’t work, reply with a few alternative windows.

Attachments: Samir_Narayanan_Resume.pdf

Best,
Marissa
Senior Recruiter, Technical Hiring
Redwood Inference
